PULSE-001.title: Overall health
PULSE-001.what: Shows the overall health of this Group Moment as a single score and status.
PULSE-001.why: Lets you instantly see whether the group is healthy, stable, or needs attention.

how.default: A 0–100 health score from participation, progress, money activity, and group signals for this Moment.
how.SHARED_EXPERIENCE: Experience Health blends trip readiness, participation, and money signals from your shared experience pulse.
how.SHARED_PURCHASE: Purchase Health reflects funding progress, contributor activity, and spend against the shared purchase goal.
how.SHARED_LIVING: Home Health reflects contribution coverage, shared expenses, and living activity for this household Moment.

PULSE-004.title: Progress
PULSE-004.what: Shows how far this Group Moment has progressed against its plan.
PULSE-004.why: Helps you see whether the group is on track.

how.default: Progress percent from tasks, milestones, activities, or funding completion for this Moment type.
how.SHARED_EXPERIENCE: Readiness / trip progress from itinerary and experience completion signals.
how.SHARED_PURCHASE: Funding progress is collected ÷ target for the shared purchase.
how.SHARED_LIVING: Coverage reflects contributions against shared living costs.

PULSE-005.title: Participation
PULSE-005.what: Measures member engagement and contribution in this Group Moment.
PULSE-005.why: Highlights collaboration health and who is showing up.

how.default: Participation score from member activity, contributions, and task completion for this Moment.
how.SHARED_EXPERIENCE: Engagement from trip activities, attendance, and shared experience events.

PULSE-006.title: Attention signals
PULSE-006.what: Highlights the highest-priority issues or pending actions right now.
PULSE-006.why: Helps the group focus on what needs attention first.

how.default: Prioritised cards from risks, pending tasks, money alerts, and AI attention rules for this Moment.

PULSE-007.title: Recent activity
PULSE-007.what: Lists the latest activities, transactions, and updates in this Group Moment.
PULSE-007.why: Shows what changed recently without jumping across screens.

how.default: Newest-first feed from the group activity timeline—expenses, tasks, contributions, and decisions.

PULSE-008.title: Next best action
PULSE-008.what: Recommends the single highest-impact next step for this Group Moment.
PULSE-008.why: Cuts decision fatigue by pointing to the most valuable action.

how.default: Chosen from health, pending work, and money state—shown with expected impact when available.

PULSE-009.title: AI insights
PULSE-009.what: Shows AI observations from patterns, trends, and group behaviour.
PULSE-009.why: Surfaces insights that are easy to miss in raw activity lists.

how.default: Insight cards from group analytics on activities, participation, and money history for this Moment.

MOMENT-002.title: People & roles
MOMENT-002.what: Shows who is in this Group Moment and their roles.
MOMENT-002.why: Makes ownership and participation clear for everyone.

how.default: Member list, roles, and invite status from group membership for this Moment.

MOMENT-003.title: Money status
MOMENT-003.what: Summarises the financial position of this Group Moment.
MOMENT-003.why: Gives money visibility without opening full finance screens.

how.default: Totals from expenses, contributions, budgets, and settlements for this Moment.
how.SHARED_EXPERIENCE: Trip spend and shared expense totals for the experience.
how.SHARED_PURCHASE: Target, collected, remaining, and spent for the purchase pool.
how.SHARED_LIVING: Shared household spend and contribution balances.

MOMENT-004.title: Activity & operations
MOMENT-004.what: Shows the operational workload—tasks, milestones, and related work.
MOMENT-004.why: Helps you see progress and what is still pending.

how.default: Counts from tasks, activities, milestones, and ops items for this Moment.

MOMENT-005.title: Assets & resources
MOMENT-005.what: Shows documents, assets, and shared resources for this Moment.
MOMENT-005.why: Keeps supporting materials easy to find for everyone.

how.default: Resource counts and categories from attachments and shared resources linked to this Moment.

MOMENT-006.title: Decisions & governance
MOMENT-006.what: Shows decisions, approvals, polls, and governance items.
MOMENT-006.why: Keeps important group decisions visible to all participants.

how.default: Latest governance items and statuses from decisions, polls, and approvals for this Moment.

MOMENT-007.title: Current state snapshot
MOMENT-007.what: AI summary of the current operating stage and focus areas.
MOMENT-007.why: Helps the group align on what matters most right now.

how.default: Generated from current progress, participation, money, and pending decisions for this Moment.

MOMENT-ITINERARY.title: Itinerary
MOMENT-ITINERARY.what: Shows planned itinerary or schedule items for the shared experience.
MOMENT-ITINERARY.why: Keeps the trip plan visible in one place.

how.default: Itinerary entries linked to this shared experience Moment.

MOMENT-GRID.title: Moments grid
MOMENT-GRID.what: Shows highlighted moment cards from this group journey.
MOMENT-GRID.why: Makes notable experiences easy to browse.

how.default: Cards from moments/highlights recorded for this Group Moment.

MOMENT-UPCOMING.title: Upcoming events
MOMENT-UPCOMING.what: Lists upcoming events on the group timeline.
MOMENT-UPCOMING.why: Helps members see what is next.

how.default: Upcoming dated events from the experience schedule for this Moment.

MEMORY-001.title: Memory timeline
MEMORY-001.what: Shows the chronological history of important group events and milestones.
MEMORY-001.why: Preserves the journey so the group can revisit how it unfolded.

how.default: Timeline entries from activities, money events, tasks, milestones, and memory events—newest first.

MEMORY-002.title: Milestone wall
MEMORY-002.what: Highlights major achievements completed during this Group Moment.
MEMORY-002.why: Makes defining accomplishments easy to recognise.

how.default: Milestone cards with completion status and dates from the group progress engine.

MEMORY-003.title: People impact
MEMORY-003.what: Ranks members who contributed the most positive impact.
MEMORY-003.why: Recognises meaningful participation across the journey.

how.default: Impact scores from participation, contributions, tasks, and money activity over the Moment.

MEMORY-004.title: Memory gallery
MEMORY-004.what: Shows photos, files, and media preserved for this Group Moment.
MEMORY-004.why: Keeps shared memories beyond day-to-day activity.

how.default: Gallery previews and counts from attachments and media linked to this Moment.

MEMORY-007.title: Memory highlights
MEMORY-007.what: Shows the most meaningful memories and defining moments.
MEMORY-007.why: Keeps the highest-value experiences easy to find.

how.default: Highlight cards ranked by significance from timeline, milestones, and gallery signals.

MEMORY-010.title: Memory intelligence
MEMORY-010.what: AI insight combining history, behaviour, and lessons from this Group Moment.
MEMORY-010.why: Turns accumulated history into knowledge for future groups.

how.default: Intelligence summary from the full memory history, behaviour, and lessons for this Moment.

LIFE-002.title: Balance model
LIFE-002.what: Shows how balanced major Group Life dimensions are relative to each other.
LIFE-002.why: Helps you spot uneven progress across group life areas.

how.default: Dimension scores for Experience, Purchase, Living (and related life dimensions) from the life balance model.

LIFE-003.title: What drives your group
LIFE-003.what: Identifies which Group Moments contribute the most positive impact.
LIFE-003.why: Shows which Moments most influence overall Group Life.

how.default: Ranked Moments with influence from cross-moment and network-effect signals in Group Life.

LIFE-005.title: Highest leverage moment
LIFE-005.what: Highlights the Group Moment with the greatest ability to lift overall Group Life.
LIFE-005.why: Focuses attention where effort compounds most.

how.default: Selected from cross-moment leverage analysis in the Group Life projection.

LIFE-006.title: Evolution timeline
LIFE-006.what: Shows how Group Life has evolved over time.
LIFE-006.why: Highlights long-term growth beyond today’s score.

how.default: Historical trend lines from life and pulse snapshots over time.

LIFE-007.title: What changed this month
LIFE-007.what: Summarises the biggest improvements and changes across Group Life this month.
LIFE-007.why: Makes recent progress easy to scan.

how.default: Month-over-month changes from Group Life monthly analytics.

LIFE-008.title: Group journey
LIFE-008.what: Shows maturity and progression of major Group Moment categories.
LIFE-008.why: Helps you see how different parts of Group Life are developing.

how.default: Journey stages per category from Group Moments progress and journey engines.

LIFE-009.title: Intelligence reflection
LIFE-009.what: AI reflection with the most meaningful insight across Group Life.
LIFE-009.why: Turns complex cross-moment data into one takeaway.

how.default: Reflection text from Group Life intelligence based on latest patterns and network effects.
